Your work. Your space.

A personal employee workspace with an original navy identity header, a refined navigation dock, grouped services and a profile photo you can choose, replace or remove.

These screens are rendered from the Flutter app with labeled development fixtures. They do not show real employee data or prove an authenticated device walkthrough.
